newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan money rates close higher on NCD issue.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan money rates close higher on NCD issue.

text.p: Taiwan's money rates finished higher on Tuesday as market liquidity tightened after the central bank issued T$5 billion in negotiable certificates of deposit on Monday, dealers said.

The overnight interbank rate was at 5.986 percent against Monday's 5.733 close, with the 30-day commercial paper rising to 5.75 percent from 5.50-5.55. Dealers expected the rate to continue its upward trend on Wednesday.
In the bond market, the 10-year 86/4 bond yield was at 6.0700-6.0950 percent against 6.0675 and the 10-year 84/1 bond yield was at 5.8400 against 5.8325. -James Lin (5080815)
